objective: Produce the governed Provider Baseline Decision and G1_PROVIDER_BASELINE dossier after all P01 evidence is consolidated, with final production selection blocked on explicit Owner jurisdiction/client-class and unresolved commercial/licensing facts.
scope: Define hard eligibility gates for provider and execution candidates
Define deterministic soft scoring criteria used only after hard gates pass
Prepare conditional shortlists for market data, macro/context and execution
Prepare G1 decision dossier and machine-readable decision state
After Human Gate, revalidate legal/provider terms and select a baseline if evidence permits
out_of_scope: Infer Owner residence, citizenship, tax residency or client class
Open accounts, complete KYC, purchase subscriptions or accept contracts
Create credentials, fund accounts or place orders
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Every final candidate must pass all hard eligibility gates
Owner jurisdiction/client class is explicit and never inferred
Required licensing/non-display rights are resolved before production baseline selection
No execution venue is selected where product/account eligibility is unknown
Soft score is not used to override a failed hard gate
G1 verdict is PASS only if all mandatory evidence is current
evidence: Fresh official legal/provider revalidation after Human Gate
rollback: Revert P01-G research/dossier/state changes only. No provider accounts, contracts, credentials or runtime changes are permitted by this task.
definition_of_ready: P01-A through P01-F canonical evidence available
definition_of_done: Owner Human Gate inputs are explicit
Required legal/provider terms are freshly revalidated
All selected baseline candidates pass hard gates
Conditional scores and tradeoffs are documented
Primary/backup/provider baseline is recorded or G1 explicitly fails/blocks with evidence
PR merges and post-merge verification succeeds
